name: Inquisitor Dusk Disciple
body:
Unhindered by the blackest nights, dusk disciples strike from the shadows, using the cover of darkness to their advantage.

A dusk disciple has the following class features.

Domain

When selecting her domain, a dusk disciple cannot select the sun domain. If a dusk disciple selects the darkness domain, she gains night hunter in place of eyes of darkness.

Night Hunter (Su)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can blend into the shadows of the night, becoming nearly invisible. As long as you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you are invisible (as per invisibility) to creatures without darkvision. You can use this ability for up to a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1).

This alters domain.

Dark Devotion

At 1st level, a dusk disciple removes all spells with the light descriptor from her spell list, and gains a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls whenever fighting in an area of dim light or darkness. Furthermore, a dusk disciple adds touch of fatigue, sleep, twilight haze, deep slumber, and waves of fatigue to her spell list at 0, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th level respectively.

This alters spells and replaces cunning initiative.

Breach the Darkness (Su)

At 1st level, as a free action, a dusk disciple can attune her eyes to the darkness to gain low-light vision and darkvision with a range of 60 feet for a number of minutes per day equal to her inquisitor level. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1 minute increments. (If a dusk disciple already has darkvision, the range of her darkvision increases by 30 feet while this ability is active.) At 5th level, while this ability is active, a dusk disciple can also see in areas of magical darkness.

This replaces discern lies.

Night Fighter (Su)

Beginning at 3rd level, when a dusk disciple confirms a critical hit, the creature must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the dusk disciple’s level + her Wisdom modifier) or perceive its surroundings to be under the effects of deeper darkness for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting effect.

At 17th level, a dusk disciple can create the effect of waves of exhaustion once per day. She treats her character level as her caster level with this effect.

In addition, a dusk disciple gains the following bonus feats at the specified levels even if she does not meet the prerequisites: Blind-Fight (3rd), Improved Blind-Fight (6th), Critical Focus (9th), Improved Critical (12th), Tiring Critical (15th), and Exhausting Critical (18th).

This replaces solo tactics, all teamwork feats, and slayer.
